name: sf_ficus_giant
about: The old Indian laurel figs (Ficus microcarpa / retusa, 30-70 inch trunks — Columbus at Broadway, owner 2026-10-16): a short pale trunk that forks almost at once into many long, smooth, twisting grey stems fanning steeply up and out, carrying a broad, dense, flat-bottomed dome high overhead — the stems bare under it
